components.name: Scan primary
components.description: The workspace scan action, with a technical keyboard hint. Loading and disabled labels come from the application.
components.html: <button class="ds-scan"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.65" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m7 4 13 8-13 8Z"/></svg>Scan Java<kbd>Ctrl ↵</kbd></button>
components.css: .ds-scan { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #333a42); border-radius: 7px; padding: 7px 12px; font: 680 13px/1.55 Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: background 160ms, border-color 160ms, transform 160ms; } .ds-scan:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #69e6ba); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-scan:active:enabled { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-scan:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-scan { margin-inline-start: auto; white-space: nowrap; background: var(--accent, #69e6ba); color: #092a21; border-color: transparent; padding: 9px 12px; } .ds-scan:hover:enabled { background: #99f2d2; color: #052217; border-color: transparent; } .ds-scan kbd { font: 11px "Geist Mono", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; margin-left: 4px; padding: 2px 4px; border: 1px solid #26745766; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Entry primary

components.css: .ds-tool { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #333a42); border-radius: 7px; padding: 7px 12px; font: 550 12px/1.5 Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: background 160ms, border-color 160ms, transform 160ms; } .ds-tool:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #69e6ba); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-tool:active:enabled { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-tool:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-tool { gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--text, #f1f4f6); } .ds-tool:hover:enabled { background: var(--raised, #242a31); border-color: var(--muted, #a2adb7); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-tool:active { transform: none; } }

components.name: Workspace-key field
components.description: A native password field and Show/Hide control within one focus boundary. The preview is static; the application wires the visibility toggle.
components.html: Use your configured key or the key printed when you started TraceWard.
components.css: .ds-key-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; color: var(--text, #f1f4f6); font: 650 13px/1.55 Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-key { display: flex; align-items: stretch; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--field-border, #66717c); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--panel, #15191e); } .ds-key:focus-within { border-color: var(--accent, #69e6ba); outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #69e6ba); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-key input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 11px 12px; color: var(--text, #f1f4f6); background: transparent; border: 0; font: 400 15px/1.55 "Geist Mono", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-key input:focus { outline: 0; } .ds-toggle { min-width: 58px; border: 0; border-left: 1px solid var(--line, #333a42); border-radius: 0; padding: 7px 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--secondary, #ccd2d8); font: 550 13px/1.55 Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms, border-color 160ms, transform 160ms; } .ds-toggle:hover:enabled { color: var(--text, #f1f4f6); background: var(--raised, #242a31); border-color: #55606a; } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #69e6ba); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-toggle:active:enabled { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-key-hint { margin: 10px 0 0; color: var(--muted, #a2adb7); font: 400 13px/1.55 Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.css: .ds-finding { border: 1px solid var(--line, #333a42); border-radius: 9px; padding: 16px; background: var(--surface, #1b2026); color: var(--text, #f1f4f6); font: 400 15px/1.55 Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-finding[data-selected='true'] { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--high, #ff9d8b) 38%, var(--line, #333a42)); } .ds-tags { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; color: var(--muted, #a2adb7); font: 400 11px/1.5 "Geist Mono", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-tags > span + span + span { margin-left: auto; } .ds-card-severity { color: var(--high, #ff9d8b); text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .06em; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 35%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 9%, transparent); padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 5px; } .ds-finding h3 { font: 700 18px/1.3 Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.035em; margin: 12px 0 4px; } .ds-card-title { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 0; color: inherit; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; font: inherit; letter-spacing: inherit; background: transparent; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms; } .ds-card-title svg { flex: none; color: var(--muted, #a2adb7); } .ds-card-title:hover svg { color: var(--accent, #69e6ba); } .ds-card-title:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-card-title:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #69e6ba); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-location { font: 400 11px/1.6 "Geist Mono", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--muted, #a2adb7); overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-finding p { font: 400 13px/1.6 Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--muted, #a2adb7); margin: 12px 0 0; }

components.name: Evidence trace
components.description: Connected source-to-sink buttons reveal code locations in the application. The sample uses illustrative symbols and line numbers.
components.css: .ds-trace { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0 0 16px; } .ds-trace li { position: relative; padding-left: 18px; } .ds-trace li::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 4px; top: 0; bottom: 0; border-left: 1px solid var(--line, #333a42); } .ds-trace li:first-child::before { top: 50%; } .ds-trace li:last-child::before { bottom: 50%; } .ds-trace li::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 1px; top: calc(50% - 3px); width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--muted, #a2adb7); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--surface, #1b2026); } .ds-trace li[data-kind='source']::after { background: var(--amber, #f4ca80); } .ds-trace li[data-kind='sink']::after { background: var(--high, #ff9d8b); } .ds-trace button { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 78px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 6px; min-height: 30px; text-align: left; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: var(--secondary, #ccd2d8); font: 550 13px/1.55 Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms, transform 160ms; } .ds-trace button:hover:enabled { background: var(--raised, #242a31); } .ds-trace button:active:enabled { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-trace button:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-trace button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #69e6ba); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-trace span, .ds-trace small { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted, #a2adb7); } .ds-trace code { color: var(--text, #f1f4f6); font: 550 12px/1.55 "Geist Mono", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-trace small { font-family: "Geist Mono", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; } @media (max-width: 480px) { .ds-trace button { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 2px 6px; } .ds-trace span { grid-column: 1/-1; } }

components.css: .ds-segments { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; max-width: 100%; align-items: stretch; min-inline-size: 0; gap: 2px; margin: 0; padding: 2px; background: var(--bg, #0d1013); border: 1px solid var(--line, #333a42); border-radius: 8px; } .ds-segments button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; padding: 4px 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--secondary, #ccd2d8); font: 550 12px/1.55 Geist, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms, border-color 160ms, transform 160ms; } .ds-segments button:hover:enabled { color: var(--text, #f1f4f6); background: var(--raised, #242a31); border-color: #55606a; } .ds-segments button[aria-pressed='true'], .ds-segments button[aria-pressed='true']:hover:enabled { color: var(--text, #f1f4f6); background: var(--raised, #242a31); border-color: var(--accent, #69e6ba); } .ds-segments button:active:enabled { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-segments button:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-segments button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #69e6ba); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 620px) { .ds-segments button { padding-inline: 5px; gap: 4px; } }

narrative.overview:
TraceWard places source code beside an inspectable record of what the scanner
observed. The visual language is calm and technical: dark graphite surfaces,
clear type, compact controls, and distinct source, propagation, and sink marks.
The workspace gives evidence room without turning each datum into a separate card.

Components feel restrained and technical. Tonal layers with subtle ambient depth
separate the working areas; borders and typography carry most of the hierarchy.
The public landing and sign-in pages use the existing lighthouse image and larger
type. That imagery is a page-specific expression, not a background for the scanner.
keyCharacteristics: One dark theme, a signal-mint action accent, and separate status colors.
Geist for interface text; Geist Mono for the editor and explicit technical labels.
Rounded rectangular controls, thin dividers, and closely grouped evidence.
Text labels alongside status color, with visible focus and reduced-motion handling.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Pair color with a label, marker, underline, or explicit state text. Preserve the distinction between severity, confidence, and completion.

rules.name: The Technical Label Rule
rules.body: Keep symbols, paths, metrics, and editor text distinct from narrative copy. Do not turn ordinary prose or every heading into monospace.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Reuse tonal steps and existing dividers before introducing another shadow. Keep the workspace shell shadow distinct from evidence markers.

rules.name: The Reviewable State Rule
rules.body: Retain “No SQL injection paths found,” diagnostics, and partial-coverage explanations as separate states. A green icon alone is not an analysis result.

dos: Do reuse the graphite hierarchy and signal mint while keeping status roles separate.
Do preserve visible text for severity, confidence, completion, errors, and partial coverage.
Do reuse the current font stacks, variable weights, control corners, and focus treatment.
Do keep source, trace, location, and remediation connected in the workspace.
Do match the relevant surface's responsive rules and respect reduced-motion preferences.
Do update this extraction and its sidecar when the underlying visual implementation changes.
donts: Don't present a clean or completed scan as a security certification.
Don't claim a light theme, strict spacing grid, or component state that the code does not implement.
Don't treat preview swatch ramps as shipped application tokens.
Don't replace the separate scan/entry action colors with one invented shared variant.
Don't expand the landing page's lighthouse treatment into every application panel.
Don't hide source-selection controls, focus indicators, or diagnostic explanations for visual simplicity.
